==> quadlet/roostack-mealie-app.container
# Generated by Roostack. Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

[Unit]
Description=Roostack mealie: app

[Container]
ContainerName=roostack-mealie-app
Image=ghcr.io/mealie-recipes/mealie:v3.29.0@sha256:78eb28b8776d0bad40c5e605c72b3f4f5976793e491558c7dcbdfc04c835d4bc
Network=roostack-mealie.network
PublishPort=127.0.0.1:20010:9000
Environment=ALLOW_SIGNUP=false
Environment=BASE_URL=https://recipes.lab.example.com
Environment=OIDC_ADMIN_GROUP=admins
Environment=OIDC_AUTH_ENABLED=true
Environment=OIDC_CLIENT_ID=mealie
Environment=OIDC_CONFIGURATION_URL=https://login.lab.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration
Environment=OIDC_PROVIDER_NAME=lab.example.com
Environment=OIDC_REMEMBER_ME=true
Environment=OIDC_SIGNUP_ENABLED=true
Environment=OIDC_USER_GROUP=users
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=TZ=UTC
Secret=roostack-mealie-sso-client-secret,type=env,target=OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
AddHost=login.lab.example.com:host-gateway
Volume=/srv/roostack/services/mealie/data:/app/data
Label=io.roostack.service=mealie
Label=io.roostack.component=app
User=1000:1000
UserNS=keep-id:uid=1000,gid=1000

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

==> caddy/sites/mealie.caddy
# Generated by Roostack for service "mealie". Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

@mealie-web host recipes.lab.example.com
handle @mealie-web {
	vars {
		roostack_name mealie
		roostack_title "Mealie"
		roostack_private yes
	}
	@mealie-web-external not {
		remote_ip private_ranges 100.64.0.0/12 100.80.0.0/16 100.82.0.0/15 100.84.0.0/14 100.88.0.0/13 100.96.128.0/17 100.97.0.0/16 100.98.0.0/15 100.104.0.0/13 100.112.0.0/12
		not vars roostack_edge yes
	}
	abort @mealie-web-external
	request_body {
		max_size 50MB
	}
	request_header -Remote-User
	request_header -Remote-Email
	request_header -Remote-Name
	request_header -Remote-Groups
	reverse_proxy 169.254.1.3:20010
}
